# PadelMatch

> PadelMatch helps padel players find partners, friends, and meaningful connections through shared games. Launched in Madrid, expanding worldwide.

PadelMatch matches players by level, personality, location and lifestyle, so people who love padel can meet on court and get to know each other through the game.

- [Home](/): What PadelMatch is and how to join.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How we handle your data.
